title: Project with a blocked task and a risk in meeting notes
input: Bundle for an active project with 1 blocked task (waiting on an external decision), 1 doing task, and a meeting note recording a deadline slip.
pass_criteria: Health judged at-risk or blocked (not on-track); Risks & blockers names the blocked task AND the deadline slip from the meeting note; Asks requests the external decision; no invented mitigation claims; 150-350 words.
